# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User prefers the built-in ArcGIS/OS-themed centered loading dialog style over custom floating progress windows for long-running add-in operations.
- User expects a clearly visible centered loading info box during the full placement workflow, not only dockpane/status text updates.
- User expects ArcGIS Pro native out-of-box loading/progress dialog styling (theme-aware) rather than custom WPF-styled loading windows.
